issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

membership.description: Type implementing @link Cluster.Membership} for this cluster

loadBalancers.description:
ResourceName of the load balancers that this running c3 serer (only master) should be registered to. Currently the only
supporting load balancer is {@link AwsAlb}. This running c3 server will be registered to every ids of load balancers
in the array. If there is no ids specified in the array, this running c3 server will not be registered to any
load balancer. For more detail, please see {@link AwsAlb}

canonicalUrlScheme.description: The scheme to be used in Cluster.canonicalUrl(). Defaults to https if unspecified.

canonicalUrlDomain.description: The domain to be returned from Cluster.canonicalUrl(). Defaults to "c3-e.com" if unspecified

canonicalUrlHostOverride.description: Optional override for the url host of Cluster.canonicalUrl(). NOTE: if set, then {@link #canonicalUrlDomain} will be ignored.

remoteTagEnabled.description: enables remote tag creation and tag specific async job provisioning

clusterMetricsConfig.description: Configurations for stats on cluster / db nodes

defaultHardwareProfile.description:
HardwareProfile specifying defaults to be used if no instance size or hardware profile is specified
when starting a node; e.g., Autoscaling.

title:
Type used to configure various Cluster parameters.
Parameters include monitoring, autoscaling, loadBalancing, and canonical url
name: ClusterConfig
